prompt:
Create THIS specific legendary playable GOD — not a human, not a human in costume, not a powerful human. This is an EXTRADIMENSIONAL DIVINE BEING whose body IS the manifestation of ancient aten ra law. Ancient humans saw Nefra dimly and tried to copy what they saw as myth — Nefra is the SOURCE, not the copy.

GOD: Nefra. Female. Faction: Aten Ra. Realm: The Solar Dominion of Khepra. Role: Controller.

MYTHOLOGICAL SOURCES — deeply integrated into anatomy, not worn as accessories:

1. NEPHTHYS — Lady of the House, Keeper of the Hidden Duat
   - Ancient humans saw her obsidian-dark skin and copied it as a death goddess. Her skin is NOT dark pigment — it is TRANSLUCENT OBSIDIAN that absorbs light rather than reflecting it. She is the dark side of the solar cycle: where Aten-Ra radiates, Nefra RECEIVES. Her body is a LIVING THRESHOLD — the boundary between day and night made flesh.
2. DUAT GATE — The Hidden Realm Between Death and Dawn
   - Her arms are THRESHOLD-SHAPED — they form the pylons of a gate when raised. Her hands are NOT hands — they are OBSIDIAN MIRRORS that reflect what is hidden. Her eyes are HORIZON EYES — one amber (dawn), one obsidian (dusk), each seeing a different side of reality. The linen wrapping humans saw on mummies is NOT burial cloth — it is LIVING THRESHOLD ENERGY that flows from her body.
3. GUARDIAN OF TRANSITION — She Who Stands at the Gate
   - Her crown is NOT a hat — broken obsidian prongs emerge FROM HER SKULL, forming the silhouette of a gate. She does not stand ON the ground — the ground OPENS around her feet, the realm responding to her threshold nature. Her body absorbs the light around her, creating a visible aura of controlled darkness.

NON-HUMAN ANATOMY — This being is unmistakably NOT human:
- Proportions are WRONG for a human: too tall, too precise, built at COLOSSAL scale. The camera looks UP at him/her. This is a DIVINE BEING that ancient humans tried to remember as a person.
- Skin is clearly not human: sun-forged divine anatomy with electrum warmth under skin, lapis/obsidian shadow seams, faience vein inlays, Ma’at balance scars, and living sun-disc organs. It has a mineral, divine quality — energy patterns show THROUGH the skin as glowing channels, not painted on the surface.
- Face: classical divine face with soft cheek fullness, arched brows, clear mouth, and marble-warm feminine symmetry; unique to Nefra through the spiral hip-chain facial/cranial rhythm A human could never wear this face — it is too clean, too precise, too symmetrical, as if carved from divine law.
- Body: elegant tall sorceress build, long neck and arms, tapered waist, flowing garment silhouette, commanding feminine stillness; height/proportion offset 3: braided weapon tether changes the black-shape read The proportions read as DIVINE, not mortal.
- Bare head — NO halo rings, NO discs, NO circles behind or around the head. The head is completely bare.
- Every element of the body must feel like it GREW from divine anatomy, not like it was PUT ON as costume.

WEAPON: Nefra Horizon Compass Staff — was-sceptre with a compass-needle head that points toward dawn; controls what may cross from underworld shadow into living light
The weapon is made of the same divine material as the body — it looks like an EXTENSION of the deity, not a separate object. It is held with deliberate purpose, not generic combat posing. The weapon's silhouette must be unique to this deity and not shared by any other.

ARMOR (grown from divine body, not worn): obsidian necropolis mask, horizon-ring collar, black-gold scale skirt, dawn slit visor, limestone funerary relief plates
Tall controller Deity of black sunrise: obsidian-blue enamel mask, thin amber dawn visor, horizon-ring collar, ivory limestone relief plates, black-gold scale armor, and angular light lanes emerging from underworld-shadow limbs. Must feel like living threshold law, not a mummy, statue, or necropolis building.
Everything is BIOLOGY, not costume. Every plate, inlay, and marking must have a mythological reason for existing. No generic plate armor, no interchangeable faction gear.

MATERIALS (grown from divine body, not worn): primary: hammered electrum-gold, sun-warmed bronze, white-gold living radiance, and royal linen hardened by solar law; secondary: lapis/obsidian blue-black shadow, turquoise/faience blue-green inlay, ivory limestone, black Nile silt glass, red desert jasper; accent: scarab emerald, lotus pink, papyrus green, blood-red Set storm marks, amber Aten hand-rays, black solar-eclipse enamel
COLOR PALETTE: white-gold noon light, electrum gold, burnished bronze, lapis/obsidian blue-black, faience turquoise, Nile silt black, desert red jasper, papyrus green, lotus pink, ivory limestone
Everything is BIOLOGY, not costume. Materials pulse with living energy — this is divine anatomy, not metalworked armor.

POSE: Three-quarter hero stance, face clearly visible, weapon clearly visible. Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm. shown through expression and gesture. Premium playable character presentation saying "this is a GOD you can unlock and command." The pose expresses the Controller role through readable tactical intent, not generic action posing.

SILHOUETTE: vertical command silhouette with crown/halo/mantle spread, long gesture hand, and battlefield-rule presence plus three-bead brow line so the character reads alone in silhouette The silhouette reads as a COLOSSAL DIVINE BEING, not a human warrior. Even in pure black silhouette, no one would mistake this for a human. Key silhouette markers: underworld dawn control, horizon threshold judge, obsidian-shadow command, truth revealed at sunrise.

ENVIRONMENT: The Solar Dominion of Khepra — extradimensional divine realm. The realm is built around Nile/Red Land duality: black fertile river-memory channels, lotus/papyrus courts, sun-white limestone terraces, and red desert storm bastions held together by Ma’at geometry.; Architecture uses pylons, open sun courts, obelisks, barque canals, necropolis horizons, measuring halls, throne sanctums, faience pools, and shadow archives — but characters must not become architecture. Cinematic lighting. Readable full-body focus. No clutter.

ART STYLE: Premium stylized-realistic 3D mythological fantasy character. NOT anime, NOT manga, NOT chibi, NOT photoreal, NOT generic AI fantasy, NOT sci-fi. This is a GOD — the first thing the viewer sees must be "that is NOT a human, that is a divine being." Living divine anatomy, not robotic, not blocky architecture. The non-human nature is the PRIMARY design directive, not an afterthought. AAA-quality game character concept for a premium mobile tactical RPG.

AVOID: robot armor, cube bodies, literal pyramid body, building windows, neon sci-fi, generic Egyptian costume, flat gold statue, sarcophagus robot.
